newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo gold market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo gold market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Tokyo gold market was closed on Monday for a public holiday. The market reopens on Tuesday.
Yen-denominated gold futures ended on Friday slightly firmer on Friday in lacklustre and rangebound trade, moving in line with the currency market, traders said.
Gold prices ranged from two to seven yen per gram firmer. Most active benchmark August was five yen firmer at 1,342 yen.
Spot gold was quoted at $382.20/50 per ounce at the Tokyo close, against $382.45/382.95 in New York on Thursday.
